REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, July 20, 2021 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
PURSUANT TO EXECUTIVE ORDER N-08-21 ISSUED BY GOVERNOR NEWSOM, THE PUBLIC AND COUNCIL MAY PARTICIPATE IN THIS MEETING VIA TELECONFERENCE. ALL VOTES TAKEN DURING THIS MEETING WILL BE BY ROLL CALL VOTE, AND THE VOTE WILL BE PUBLICLY REPORTED.
The public may participate in the meeting via a computer or smart device by logging into ZOOM at the following link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85032157326
You may enter your name when prompted do so. If you wish to provide public comment at either the beginning of the meeting or for a particular item, you may either (a) contact the City Clerk's Office before the meeting and provide your name or (b) utilize the "raise hand" option located under the participant's name. Once you click on this option you will be in the rotation to make a public comment.
Please note, if you do not have the audio feature on your device you will need to call (669) 900-6833 and enter ZOOM Meeting ID: 850 3215 7326 then press pound (#). When prompted to enter the participation ID number press pound (#) again. To make a public comment enter "*9". The Clerk's office will be notified, and you will be announced to make a public comment.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution via the City of Lomita website or by contacting the Deputy City Clerk at l.abbott@lomitacity.com.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
This meeting will be conducted in compliance with CDC guidelines and applicable orders of the Los Angeles County Health Officer.

In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five-minute time limit per person has been established. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibits the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, requests for clarification or factual information, or placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.

  City Manager Smoot stated that the City's annual summer movie nights have resumed. The

  Tonight's meeting was posted as a hybrid meeting, so he wanted to give members of the

8. DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF A MEMORIAL, LOCATED AT TEUCHERT
  PARK, IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE LAS VEGAS MASS SHOOTING VICTIMS

  RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve the proposed plan to incorporate a new memorial at
  Teuchert Park located at 1836-1850 259s Place.

  Page 4 of 6
 Lomita City Council Regular Meeting Minutes
July 20, 2021

  Management Analyst Vida presented the staff report as per the agenda material.

  Mayor Waronek thanked Andrew Aparicio of Element Outdoor Living, Gil Torres of Thompson
  Building Materials, and Luigi Schiappa for providing expertise and supplies pro bono for the
  memorial.

  City Manager Smoot stated that the goal is to have the memorial completed by the end of
  September so that a small ceremony can be held on the anniversary of the tragedy,
  October 1 -

  Henry Sanchez, a Lomita resident, spoke in support of the memorial. His daughter survived
  the mass shooting.

  There being no further requests to speak, Mayor Waronek brought the item back to the
  Council for further discussion or a motion.

  Council Member Uphoff made a motion, seconded by Council Member Gazeley to approve
  the proposed plan to incorporate a new memorial at Teuchert Park located at
  1836-1850 259h Place.

  AYES: Council Members: Gazeley, Uphoff, Waite, Mayor Pro Tem Segawa, and Mayor
  Waronek
  NOES: None
  ABSENT: None

9. DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF SENDING A LETTER TO THE DISTRICT
  ATTORNEY'S OFFICE REGARDING SPECIAL DIRECTIVES

  RECOMMENDED ACTION: Review and discuss the attached letter requested by the City
  Council, and if approved, direct the City Manager to sign and transmit to the Office of the
  District Attomey.

  City Manager Smoot presented the staff report as per the agenda material.

  Council Member Waite stated that he did not support the lette/s comments regarding Special
  Directives 20-06 and 20-08, but would endorse the letter with the removal of those two
  passages.

  Henry Sanchez, a Lomita resident, stated that the letter does not go far enough in expressing
  opposition to the District Attorney's special directives. He added that he is in favor of recalling
  the District Aftorney.

  There being no further requests from the public to speak, Mayor Waronek brought the item
  back to Council for further discussion or a motion.

  Council Member Gazeley made a motion, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Segawa to direct the
  City Manager to sign and transmit the letter to the Ofiice of the District Attomey.

  AYES: Council Members: Gazeley, Uphoff, Mayor Pro Tem Segawa, and Mayor Waronek
  NOES: Council Members: Waite
  ABSENT: None
  Page 5 of 6
 Lomita City Council Regular Meeting Minutes
July 20,2021

  City Manager Smoot was directed to transmit the letter.

10. DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING AMENDMENT
  NO. 3 TO THE CITY MANAGER EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

  RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt resolution 2021-26 approving Amendment No. 3 to the
  January 27 , 20'16, City Manager Employment Agreement (as previously amended).

  City Attorney Rusin presented the staff report as per the agenda material.

  Henry Sanchez, a Lomita resident, expressed his support for the amendment to the
  employment agreement.

  There being no further requests from the public to speak, Mayor Waronek brought the item
  back to Council for further discussion or a motion.

  Council Member Gazeley made a motion, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Segawa to adopt the
  resolution.

  AYES: Council Members: Gazeley, Uphoff, Waite, Mayor Pro Tem Segawa, and Mayor
  Waronek
  NOES: None
  ABSENT: None

  Adopted the following titled resolution:

  RESOLUTION NO.2021.26. A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING AMENDMENT NO. 3 TO THE CITY MANAGER'S
  EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  None scheduled
